carrier.decompiler_warning: Third-party pseudocode, not original source; variable binding/control-flow may be incorrect. Numeric configs and key layout formulas cross-checked against HASM where noted.

units.layout_unit: React Native density-independent layout units (dp); asset intrinsic pixels are separate.
units.physical_pixel_conversion: For this measured reference canvas, physical/reference pixels=sc(value)*2.625. On other devices use the actual density and safe-area geometry; do not substitute width/380.
units.unity_y: RN uses top-left y-down; a bottom-left Unity transform must invert y about the actual content/safe-area height.
units.measurement_source: Root agent measured source avatar49/toggle64/action80 against reference screenshots. This subtask did not operate the phone.

button.method: Layer outer horizontal 3-slice frame and inner horizontal 3-slice fill. Do not stretch a single complete button bitmap.

slice.rightCap: Use explicit capR when supplied; otherwise reuse left cap with scaleX=-1

button.inner_fill_bounds: side/top/bottom insets are Math.round(actualButtonHeight*eachRatio), not percentages of width.
button.height: actualHeight=Math.round(nominalHeight*1.15), Mozaik game meta buttonHeightScale=1.15. Default PlayButton nominal220x90 => actualHeight104dp; resume nominal80 => actual92dp.
button.content_alignment: content translateY=(buttonFaceCenter(frameVariant)-buttonFaceCenter(null))*actualHeight, rounded to nearest device pixel; only when a frameVariant is supplied.

interaction.spring_or_press_scale: No spring/timing/onPressIn/onPressOut found in PlayButton/NineSliceButton. Do not add invented press shrink.

popup.method: 9-slice card + 3-slice banner. Right-side/top-right/bottom-right mirror left pieces.

mount_animation.backdrop: Backdrop is separate/static, not driven by card opacity.
mount_animation.exit_animation: No mirrored exit timing was established in the inspected Popup function; unmount/onClose behavior is caller-owned.

pause.popup: Uses shared Popup mount animation above.

background.source_mode: Image uses original intrinsic aspect; exact crop requires parent actual layout path.

levelSignSlot.paddingTop: 100 + measured top/event height if >0, otherwise sc100; pseudocode measured-variable binding needs HASM/geometry cross-check

animation_engine.spring_conversion: stiffness=(OrigamiTension-30)*3.62+194; damping=(OrigamiFriction-8)*3+25; mass default1. Do not feed raw tension/friction into Unity physical spring.
animation_engine.conversion_warning: The decompiler displays the first parameter twice in module328; actual friction is the second parameter, cross-checked by parent in source bytecode.
animation_engine.timing_default: module329 TimingAnimation: easing defaults to Easing.inOut(Easing.ease); duration defaults500ms, delay0. Use the specified per-call duration when present.
animation_engine.not_equal: RN spring settles by displacement/speed thresholds, not an arbitrary fixed duration. Native Android animation frame scheduling and font rasterization remain runtime-dependent.
